classification: 215 post-hoc branches share one retained natural failure. They are not independent natural journeys or a human win rate. Original policy still ends at floor30/dead with 21 deaths and only29 cleared floors.

openingEnemy.name: 裂星守望
openingEnemy.label: 每三回合重筑最大生命 5% 的护盾
openingEnemy.warning: 第 3 / 6 / 9… 次反击后重筑护盾，上限为初始护盾。

limits: This finite single-item branch set does not establish an optimal full loadout or a general win rate.

The two illustrative defensive alternatives were noticed during an earlier exploratory read of this terminal inventory; the full exhaustive branch matrix prevents those successes from hiding the other observed outcomes.
UI navigation and accessibility require separate browser checks; engine legality alone is not proof of a reachable control.
